resources.string: Choose an available format for permitted public media. Private by default, with encrypted remote connections.
Paste an HTTPS media or supported public platform link.
Only source formats compatible with this Android version are shown. MP4/WebM tracks can be combined without transcoding. MP3 conversion and DRM are unavailable.

Download only content you own or have permission to save. Public YouTube, Instagram, X and Facebook extraction is experimental and may be unavailable for a particular link. Sign-in, private, restricted or DRM content is not bypassed.
Remove terminal history entries? Private files remain until deleted here or app data is cleared. Keep entries to manage their files.
Permanently delete this file and its history entry?
Network and folder preferences apply when a download is added. Active jobs retain their original settings.
Android requires a foreground service notification while downloading. This setting controls optional completion notifications only.
HTTP can expose or alter media in transit. HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects are always rejected.
Downloads / J Video Downloader (Android 10+). App storage on Android 8–9; share or choose a folder to keep files after uninstall.

No account, ads, tracking or backend. Media and history remain in private internal app storage with backups disabled. The selected public platform and media hosts receive your IP and requests through TLS. Extraction uses a bundled yt-dlp/Python/QuickJS runtime, a bounded local process and an authenticated loopback TLS tunnel gate. Signed media URLs stay in memory; only the original public page and chosen format ID are persisted. No imported cookies, passwords or login tokens. Remote plaintext requests and unsafe redirects are blocked. FileProvider is not exported; only explicit Open/Share grants temporary read permission. Uninstall or clear app data deletes private files. Clearing history retains files. Do not download without the required rights. No guarantee covers every platform link or device; this build still requires Android validation.
Developed for Jameel · No ads · No tracking
Enter a valid public HTTPS link without login credentials, fragments or explicit authentication tokens.
This link requires access not available to the app. Private content, authentication and DRM are not bypassed.
Unsafe destination or redirect blocked. Only public media hosts are allowed.
This is not a supported direct video/audio response, or the media format changed. HTML pages, playlists and DRM streams are unsupported.
Access restricted or link expired. No sign-in or access bypass is available.
The media is unavailable or has been removed.
Not enough storage. Free space and retry. A temporary copy is required.
Cannot access storage. Re-select the download folder and try again.
This URL is already queued or downloading.
The queue is full (10 items). Wait for a download to finish.
This file was moved or deleted. Its history entry is still available.
Connection interrupted or file incomplete. Automatic retries are limited; failed downloads can be retried manually.
Secure connection failed. Certificate validation remains enabled.
The server is limiting requests. Wait and retry later.
The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
Private app storage. Files are removed when app data is cleared or the app is uninstalled. Open/Share grants temporary read access only after your action.
No compatible secure file format is available, or the selected quality changed. Analyze again and choose an available format. Adaptive-only streams and incompatible muxing are unavailable.
Extraction failed, timed out, exceeded its memory-output limit, or needs an engine update. Login/region restrictions are not bypassed. No platform support is guaranteed for every link.
